overview: The Central Expanse is the largest and most unstable section of Marus Seru.
details: Geomantic forces fracture the plateau, creating crystal fields and unstable stone shelves. Stone creatures migrate through the expanse in large packs.
hooks: A massive geomantic quake splits the plateau.
Crystal resonance fields pulse with arcane energy.
Stone creature migrations surge toward the Seru frontier.
A Seru patrol disappears near a new fissure.
A giant stone sentinel awakens from beneath the plateau.
